summary: Eastman Chemical Company filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $300 million offering of 5.500% notes due February 25, 2030, priced at 99.884% of par (0.350% underwriting discount, 99.534% net proceeds of $298.602 million). Interest pays semi-annually from February 25, 2027; settlement is expected on or about November 12, 2026. The notes are unsecured, rank pari passu with other senior unsecured debt, and carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase put plus an optional make-whole redemption. Joint book-runners are Citigroup, Mizuho, BofA, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and Wells Fargo. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing needs.
